I couldn't do this research, so I don't have any notes on Amos 3 for you yet.

My first attempt tried to open eight commentary pages at once, and it went over the tool's usage limit. My second attempt, a single page, was refused because I had no tool calls left for this turn. No source pages loaded. You asked me to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge, so I haven't written anything. Notes from memory would break that rule.

**To pick this up in a new turn, I'd fetch these pages one or two at a time:**
- enduringword.com/bible-commentary/amos-3/ (David Guzik)
- preceptaustin.org's Amos 3 commentary page
- biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/amos/3.htm, /gill/amos/3.htm, /pulpit/amos/3.htm and /barnes/amos/3.htm
- studylight.org/commentaries/eng/wen/amos-3.html (Wesley's Explanatory Notes)
- netbible.org/bible/Amos+3 (translators' notes)

After that I'd run targeted searches on the sites you listed. These verses are the ones most likely to show differences between traditions or other views:
- **v. 2:** "Only you have I known" (being chosen and being held to account)
- **v. 6:** "has not the LORD caused it?" (God's control over disaster)
- **v. 7:** prophets revealing God's plan, which matters in debates about whether prophecy continues today
- **vv. 12 and 14:** the "rescued remnant" picture and the altars at Bethel

If you'd like me to go ahead, just reply and I'll start, fetching slowly to stay under the limit.
